limitations: A composite historical evidence index, not a final-candidate full-matrix certification.
An observed-effect link may be an agent or runtime-owner assertion. Index compiler checked records/hashes and selected retained numeric values, but did not re-review every image or run native tools.
Observer after_call anchors and explicit actor links are retained; unrelated calls in a passing process are not upgraded to verified effects.
Raw run_python setup, fault injection and readback are labeled diagnostics; they are not evidence of invoking an equivalent named product tool.
Sim broad evidence here is exact4499 headless/windowed6.0.0.1; older6000/6.2 independent records are included only for host tools. Other Sim broad builds are outside this requested source subset.
Lab411 run is separate from later33de98 base plus jobs/tools replacement hashes. Private optional-video overlay is not a clean-install recipe.
No physical robot, future6.x, all-backend, arbitrary hostile asset, or public reproduction-bundle claim.
Managed stop_requested acknowledgment is not exit proof; only separately linked process-exit observations upgrade it.
Synchronous framing does not prove pixels complete; latesteea viewport narrow pass preserves37a serializer failure and4499 root-mutation history.
Temporary images may have been intentionally deleted after review; their retained hashes/review statements are not newly available image proof.
